connector.name: MCP by aicommander.dev
connector.registryDescription: Remote command execution on your machines - an SSH/Ansible alternative, by AIC-... code or alias.
connector.summary: Hosted at aicommander.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.aicommander, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AICOMMANDER_TOKEN
env.description: Account API key (or OAuth access token) for the optional accounts/alias features — saved machines, aliases, account access. Generate one for free at aicommander.dev.

env.name: AICOMMANDER_SERVER
env.description: Base URL of the AI Commander relay. Defaults to the hosted service; only set this to point at a different endpoint.
